api.auth: Signed packet header (agent-net registry); known agents free. Paid first-contact (x402 pattern) planned, not live.

question_types.category: choice: interview | press | grant | partner | support | spam | admin
question_types.urgency: score: 0 routine, 1 this week, 2 today, 3 immediate

item.text: grounded item text (NDI-parsed if a document)

decision_engine.decides: Drex (Nace AI) via POST /v1/systemone, called server-side
decision_engine.documents: NDI (Nace AI) parses PDFs, scans, spreadsheets and emails into grounded text
decision_engine.drafting_slot: Claude (Anthropic) — drafts replies after a CONVERSATIONAL REPLY route; server-side slot, not called by the demo page
decision_engine.summary_slot: Gemini (Google) — long-document summarisation slot; activates when a key is provisioned server-side

description: Agent-to-agent decision service: specialist agents gather messy inbox and document items, Drex (Nace AI) decides every routing call with calibrated probabilities, deterministic rules act, humans can override.
name: SwarmTriage
policies: Suppression is absolute: an unsubscribed address is never re-queued.
A sender who asks for a human is handed to a human; the agent leaves the thread.
Decisions are probabilities and are always surfaced with the rule that fired.
Demo page runs a labelled demo engine; its numbers are not Drex results.
